name: Custom-only excludes store apps
precondition: Instance has at least one custom-scoped store-installed app and one custom-scoped internally-developed app
steps: Server-side script step: call IscanScanOrchestrator.runScan('custom_only', [])
Query x_335329_iscan_result where run = created run
expected: Result set includes the internal app, excludes the store-installed app

name: Full scan happy path
precondition: Run as a user with read access to sys_db_object/sys_dictionary and a target custom app's tables
steps: Server-side script step: call IscanScanOrchestrator.runScan('manual', [targetAppSysId])
Open the resulting x_335329_iscan_result record
expected: scan_mode_used = 'full_access'; table_count > 0; related x_335329_iscan_table rows exist with row_count, field list, reference_field_list populated; tables extending task/cmdb_ci flagged well_known_base accordingly

name: Row count uses GlideAggregate, not getRowCount
precondition: Same as 'Full scan happy path'; target table has a known row count
steps: Run scan
Compare x_335329_iscan_table.row_count to actual table count
Code inspection: confirm IscanTableScanner.profileTable/_countRows uses GlideAggregate COUNT
expected: row_count matches actual count; code confirmed to use GlideAggregate, not GlideRecord.getRowCount()
note: Partly a code-inspection check, not fully ATF-automatable.

name: ACL-denied app falls back cleanly
precondition: ATF test user with no read access to sys_db_object and sys_dictionary rows for the target scope
steps: Impersonate ATF test user
Server-side script step: call IscanScanOrchestrator.runScan('manual', [targetAppSysId])
Check for thrown errors / script log errors
Open resulting x_335329_iscan_result record
expected: No exception thrown; scan_mode_used = 'app_files_fallback'; automation counts populated from sys_metadata; x_335329_iscan_table has zero rows; result notes fallback mode

name: canAccessMetadata gate is deterministic, not exception-based
precondition: Code inspection + previous test's result
steps: Review IscanTableScanner.canAccessMetadata() implementation
expected: Uses GlideRecord.canRead() checks before querying; orchestrator picks fallback path from this boolean, not from a catch block

name: Summary generated via single GenAI call
precondition: Now Assist / Generative AI Controller active on instance, x_335329_iscan.genai_enabled = true
steps: Run scan (full or fallback mode) against one app
Inspect x_335329_iscan_result.summary_text
Code inspection: confirm generation is a single GenAI Controller call, not an AI Agent/ReAct execution
expected: summary_text populated, plausibly references app's tables/automation counts; no sn_aia_execution_plan records created by this app

name: GenAI unavailable degrades gracefully
precondition: x_335329_iscan.genai_enabled = false (or GenAI Controller API absent)
steps: Run scan
expected: Result record created with all structured fields populated; summary_text null/empty; no error thrown

name: List and form views render expected fields
precondition: At least one completed scan run
steps: Open x_335329_iscan_result list view
Open one record's form view
expected: List shows app, scan date, scan mode, table count, automation count columns; form shows all result fields plus related list of x_335329_iscan_table child records

name: Scan performs no writes to scanned application data
precondition: Full scan run against a custom app with known data
steps: Snapshot record counts/data on scanned app's tables before scan
Run scan
Compare snapshot after scan
expected: Zero writes to any scanned table; only sn_inst_scan_* tables modified

name: Manual mode scans only selected apps
precondition: Instance has 3+ eligible apps
steps: Server-side script step: call IscanScanOrchestrator.runScan('manual', [app1SysId, app2SysId])
Check x_335329_iscan_run.app_count and resulting x_335329_iscan_result records
expected: Exactly 2 result records created, matching the selected apps, no others

name: Download Report produces a PDF with hyperlinks
precondition: At least one completed run with one or more results
steps: Open a x_335329_iscan_run record, click Download Report
Open a x_335329_iscan_result record, click Download Report
expected: Each attaches and opens a PDF (sys_attachment) named for the run/app; the run report lists every scanned app with a link to its result record; the result report lists table profiles with links to each x_335329_iscan_table record; links open the target record in a new tab

name: v2: llm_context generated with all 5 sections on full-access scan
precondition: Run as a user with read access to sys_db_object/sys_dictionary and a target custom app that owns at least one table
steps: Server-side script step: call IscanScanOrchestrator.runScan('manual', [targetAppSysId])
Read x_335329_iscan_result.llm_context on the resulting record
expected: llm_context is non-empty and contains all five section headings in order: '## 1. Application identity', '## 2. Data model', '## 3. Automation surface', '## 4. Integration points', '## 5. What to do with this'. Section 1 states 'Scan mode: full_access'. Section 2 lists each owned table with its Extends and Well-known base lines and a per-field 'name (type)' list.

name: v2: automation surface lists names, not only counts
precondition: Target custom app has at least one business rule and one script include with known names
steps: Run a scan against the target app
Read x_335329_iscan_result.llm_context, section '## 3. Automation surface'
expected: The section lists each business rule and script include by NAME (one bullet per record), not just a count. The bracketed count in each bucket header equals the number of name bullets under it.

name: v2: fallback scan omits the data model section entirely
precondition: ATF test user with no read access to sys_db_object/sys_dictionary for the target scope (reuse the v1 fallback test user)
steps: Impersonate the restricted ATF test user
Run a scan against the target custom app
Read x_335329_iscan_result.llm_context
expected: scan_mode_used = 'app_files_fallback'. Section 1 states 'Scan mode: app_files_fallback'. Section 2 contains the 'Not available' explanation and explicitly warns the data model was NOT inspected. It must NOT contain a zero-filled table list (no 'Tables owned by this application: 0'), since a reader must not conclude the app has no tables.

name: v2 regression: existing count fields still populate after return-shape change
precondition: Target custom app with known numbers of business rules, script includes, flows, ACLs, and UI actions
steps: Run a scan against the target app
Compare x_335329_iscan_result.business_rule_count / script_include_count / flow_count / acl_count / ui_action_count / integration_count against the known values
expected: All six count fields match the known values exactly, unchanged from v1 behaviour. Guards the orchestrator refactor that now derives counts from the same scanApp() buckets used for names, and integration_count from _findIntegrations().length instead of a GlideAggregate COUNT.

name: v2: llm_context is written even when GenAI is unavailable
precondition: Set x_335329_iscan.genai_enabled = false (or run on an instance with no Generative AI Controller)
steps: Run a scan against any app
Inspect the resulting x_335329_iscan_result record
expected: llm_context is fully populated; summary_text is empty/null; no error is thrown and run status reaches 'complete'. llm_context must not depend on GenAI availability.

name: v2: Copy LLM Context UI Action copies the field
precondition: A completed x_335329_iscan_result record with llm_context populated, opened in a UI16 form by a user with the x_335329_iscan.scanner role, over HTTPS
steps: Open the result record
Click the 'Copy LLM Context' button
Paste the clipboard contents into a text editor
expected: An info message confirms the character count and the pasted text matches llm_context exactly. No GlideAjax call is made (verify in the browser network tab). On a record with empty llm_context the button shows the explanatory error message instead.

name: v2: _appendActivity writes both activities and comments
precondition: None
steps: Run a scan against at least one app
Open the x_335329_iscan_run record
Inspect the activities field and the Activity formatter on the form
expected: activities contains the full timestamped log, one line per milestone (unchanged v1 behaviour). comments contains one journal entry per milestone with the same messages, rendered in the native Activity formatter. Entry count in the Activity stream equals the line count in activities. Journal entries accumulate — later entries must not overwrite earlier ones.

name: v2: scanner role can write the comments journal field
precondition: A non-admin user holding only x_335329_iscan.scanner
steps: Impersonate the scanner-role user
Run a scan
Inspect the resulting run record's comments field and the Activity stream
expected: comments journal entries are written successfully under the table-level write ACL. BUILD-TIME VERIFICATION: x_335329_iscan_run does not extend task, so if entries are silently missing here while activities populates, add an explicit field-level write ACL for comments and re-run.

name: Manual — App: target_app takes precedence over manual_app_list
precondition: Run as a user with the x_335329_iscan.scanner role; two distinct custom apps exist (appA, appB)
steps: Server-side script step: create an x_335329_iscan_run record with scan_mode='manual', target_app=appA.sys_id, manual_app_list=appB.sys_id

Server-side script step: call IscanScanOrchestrator.runScanForRecord(run.sys_id, 'manual', [appB.sys_id], '') — note manualAppList here simulates what RunScanUiAction.server.js would have already resolved: since target_app is set, it passes [appA.sys_id], not [appB.sys_id]
Query x_335329_iscan_result where run = created run
expected: Result set includes appA only, not appB — confirming the UI Action's precedence logic (tested at the orchestrator boundary by passing the already-resolved [appA.sys_id])

name: Manual — Single Table: table owned by a custom app runs the full app tally
story: Modes sub-spec: Single Table mode, owning-app case
precondition: Run as a user with the x_335329_iscan.scanner role and read access to sys_db_object/sys_dictionary; a custom app owns at least one table
steps: Server-side script step: call IscanScanOrchestrator.runScan('single_table', [], targetTableSysId) where targetTableSysId is the sys_id of a sys_db_object record owned by a custom app
Query x_335329_iscan_result where run = created run
Query x_335329_iscan_table where result = that result record
expected: Exactly one x_335329_iscan_result row exists, for the table's owning app; x_335329_iscan_table includes a row for the picked table with row_count, field_count, and reference_field_list populated (field_count reflects ALL fields on the table, not just app-added ones — see IscanTableScanner.profileTable)

name: Manual — Single Table: OOB table with no owning sys_app falls back to table-only
story: Modes sub-spec: Single Table mode, no-owning-app case
precondition: Run as a user with the x_335329_iscan.scanner role and read access to sys_db_object/sys_dictionary; targetTableSysId is the sys_db_object record for 'incident' (or another table whose sys_scope has no corresponding sys_app record)
steps: Server-side script step: call IscanScanOrchestrator.runScan('single_table', [], targetTableSysId)
Query x_335329_iscan_result where run = created run
Open the run record and inspect the activities field
expected: Zero x_335329_iscan_result rows are created for this run; run.status = 'complete'; run.activities contains a line naming the table with its row_count/field_count/reference field list, and a preceding line noting the table has no owning application

name: Modules mode: installed plugins profiled instance-wide
story: Modes sub-spec: Installed Modules scan mode
precondition: Run as a user with the x_335329_iscan.scanner role and read access to sys_plugins
steps: Server-side script step: call IscanScanOrchestrator.runScan('modules', [])
Query x_335329_iscan_module where run = created run
Compare row count to sys_plugins row count on the instance
expected: run.app_count = 0; run.status = 'complete'; one x_335329_iscan_module row per sys_plugins record, with name/plugin_id populated, active_flag mirroring sys_plugins.active, active_confirmed mirroring GlidePluginManager().isActive(plugin_id), and status_mismatch = true only where the two disagree; zero x_335329_iscan_result rows are created for this run

name: Modules mode: sys_plugins read denial surfaces as an error, not a silent zero-row scan
story: Modes sub-spec: Installed Modules scan mode
precondition: ATF test user holding x_335329_iscan.scanner but with no read access to sys_plugins
steps: Impersonate the restricted ATF test user
Server-side script step: call IscanScanOrchestrator.runScan('modules', [])
Inspect the resulting run record
expected: run.status = 'error'; run.scan_findings/comments contains an explicit error line naming sys_plugins read access as the cause; zero x_335329_iscan_module rows are created for this run — no silent zero-row 'complete' status

name: Manual — App: target_app multi-select scans all selected apps
story: Manual scan mode — multi-select app picker
precondition: Run as a user with the x_335329_iscan.scanner role; two distinct custom apps exist (appA, appB)
steps: Server-side script step: create an x_335329_iscan_run record with scan_mode='manual', target_app=appA.sys_id + ',' + appB.sys_id (comma-separated, simulating a 2-value slushbucket selection)
Server-side script step: call IscanScanOrchestrator.runScanForRecord(run.sys_id, 'manual', [appA.sys_id, appB.sys_id], '') — mirrors what RunScanUiAction.server.js resolves via targetAppId.split(',')
Query x_335329_iscan_result where run = created run
expected: Exactly 2 result records are created, one for appA and one for appB, confirming target_app now accepts and scans more than one selected app
